text: Woe{H1945} to them that are at ease{H7600} in Zion,{H6726} and to them that are secure{H982} in the mountain{H2022} of Samaria,{H8111} the notable{H5344} men of the chief{H7225} of the nations,{H1471} to whom the house{H1004} of Israel{H3478} come!{H935}

ye that rejoice{H8056} in a thing{H1697} of nought,{H3808} that say,{H559} Have we not taken{H3947} to us horns{H7161} by our own strength?{H2392}
